1. **Rest:** It’s okay (and wise) to take it easy today. Try to keep weight off your knee as much as possible.
2. **Ice:** If you haven’t already, applying a cold pack (or even a bag of frozen peas wrapped in a towel) for 15–20 minutes every couple of hours can help reduce soreness and any swelling.

4. **Compression:** If you have a soft knee brace or an elastic bandage, gently wrapping your knee can provide support and help with swelling—just make sure it’s not too tight.
